note: Loading this file does not authorize spend, fallback, or a profile switch.

applicable_endpoint.description: BigModel OpenAI-compatible chat completions host as documented
applicable_endpoint.parser_rule: Do not invent a second URL parser. Unrecognized endpoint overrides fail closed and do not inherit free status.

reasoning.omit_rule: Never omit reasoning_effort; the documented default is max.

retired_models.note: FlashX variants, glm-4.7 (non-flash), and generic aliases are excluded.

pricing.cache_storage: Cache storage is temporarily free and must not be treated as a permanent free inference grant.
pricing.invalidation: An expired temporary offer never converts free_only traffic into paid traffic. Stale pricing freezes promotion until a reviewed refresh that does not spend on inference.

eligibility_requirements: Eligible means active, price-verified, policy-compatible, within context and output limits, and qualified for required tools and modality on the exact execution lane.
Unknown terms or capability are not free exhausted; block or qualify first.
A skipped ineligible candidate needs an evidence-backed reason, not an attempt.
Do not silently truncate a larger-context task onto a smaller-context fallback.
context_output_limits: Unknown context or output limits block eligibility. Do not silently truncate a task to fit a smaller fallback.
modality: This ordered list is text and coding only. Vision models are not members of this list and are not automatic text fallbacks.

lane_qualification.note: No lane is qualified. Direct API, Cline, and PT SDK results stay separate and are not recorded here.

error_classes.rule: Valid completion and required task checks pass. Stop the chain.
Verified model retired or unavailable. Skip to the next eligible free candidate.
Proven required capability absent. Record it and continue to the next eligible free candidate.
Definitive non-executing model-specific rejection. Correct a known schema or continue to the next free candidate.
HTTP 429 code 1113 means insufficient balance or no usable package. No retry and no paid escalation.
Authentication or permission error. Halt the task.
Ordinary documented rate limit. Bounded backoff only. No account cycling.
Generic 400. Inspect it and do not infer effort incompatibility.
Timeout, network interruption, or 5xx. Contain and reconcile. No blind replay.
Partial stream, tool effects, or unknown cancellation. Stop automatic fallback.
Safety or policy rejection. Do not evade it by switching models.
Deterministic failure on a clean evaluation fixture. Next free candidate only under an approved policy.

retry.note: Zero inference retries during qualification; at most one documented throttle retry later. No account cycling.

tool_billing.note: Provider-hosted web search, paid retrieval, and knowledge services are disabled in free_only.

paid_gate: Explicit per-run operator authorization for glm-5.3-flash and this endpoint.
Positive finite CNY budget, token/request limits and task deadline.
Complete free-candidate ledger or approved ineligibility exclusions.
Account entitlement resolved; unresolved 1113 blocks paid dispatch.
Fresh applicable rates and a conservative token-cost reservation.
No outstanding ambiguous request consuming an unaccounted reservation.

interfaces_not_implemented.select_next_candidate: Choose the next eligible candidate from this ordered list using task requirements and the evidence ledger, without contacting a provider.
interfaces_not_implemented.classify_provider_result: Map an HTTP status, structured provider code, and execution state to one error class in this policy.
interfaces_not_implemented.authorize_paid_candidate: Allow glm-5.3-flash only after every paid_gate string in this policy is satisfied for that run.
interfaces_not_implemented.build_provider_request: Build one provider request that follows the selected candidate's reasoning rules and never sends max or xhigh.
